messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 PAGING: Elevated latency observed on hosted-api canary (region-us-east-1). Auto-alert threshold crossed: p95 > 700ms for 5m. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-14T22:12:03Z rolled commit abcdef1 -> canary (service: inference-hosted).

alex: I'm on it. Pulling traces and canary metrics.

maria: seeing p50 ~120ms but p95 jumped to ~950ms on canary shards 3/6. Production (non-canary) stable.

alex: logs show repeated KV cache misses and churn around the same time as the deploy. Sample log:

```
2026-03-14T22:12:10Z inference-hosted[shard-3]: warn KVCache miss for key user:session:abc123
2026-03-14T22:12:10Z inference-hosted[shard-3]: debug PrefetchAttempt id=0x7fae error=timeout
2026-03-14T22:12:11Z inference-hosted[shard-3]: error cache_eviction spike=312
```

jordan: that commit abcdef1 included the new kv-prefetch optimizer (feature flag: prefetch_kv_cache=true). Could be the regression.

support-lead: any customer-facing errors? SLOs?

eva: A couple of clients (AcmeCorp, NovaApps) reported increased tail latency and 502s for long-context requests. Looks like ~2 unique customers affected, ~0.8% of active keys; 4% of requests to canary saw >500ms, 0.15% experienced 500s.

sahil: agree likely introduced by feature flag behavior in abcdef1. Propose immediate mitigation: kill flag on canary and revert the commit if needed. Thoughts?

alex: I'll kill the flag first (least disruptive) and monitor. Command I'm going to run: `redwood ff disable prefetch_kv_cache --env canary --by alex`

ops-bot: Executing: `redwood ff disable prefetch_kv_cache --env canary`

ops-bot: Feature flag "prefetch_kv_cache" set to OFF on canary (propagating), actor=alex.

maria: flag kill propagated to all canary nodes. p95 dropping already on shards where flag disabled from 950ms -> 280ms in ~30s. Good signal.

alex: nice. patch or revert? I can do quick rollback of single commit if we want rollback to be fully safe.

sahil: since production not affected, I'd prefer a targeted revert on canary and then a small patch for the prefetch backoff logic before promoting. But we should err on safety. Do rollback to previous canary image (pre-abcdef1).

deploy-bot: Rollback command suggestion: `redwood deploy rollback --service inference-hosted --env canary --to-tag v20260314-0823`

alex: Performing rollback to tag v20260314-0823 now.

ops-bot: Triggered rollback job id=rb-20260314-007 by alex.

incident-bot: Note: Pager escalation paused while mitigation in progress.

maria: rollback completed on all canary hosts. Telemetry: p95 stabilized to 160-200ms, error rate back to baseline.

support-lead: Customer impact summary for ops notes: canary-only, 2 customers reported symptoms via support, production customers unaffected. No emergency customer outreach needed, but notify those customers with root cause and timeline.

jordan: creating small patch branch to fix aggressive prefetch backoff (reduce concurrent prefetches and add jitter). I'll open PR referencing abcdef1 and target hotfix commit abcdef1-hotfix-1.

alex: For audit/rollback log: I reverted the canary deploy and killed the flag. Commands logged in ops ticket #INC-2026-045.

eva: handing off to sahil (next on-call) for monitoring and post-deploy validation. sahil, please ensure canary remains stable for 2 hours before we consider re-rolling with the patch.

sahil: taking handoff. Checklist: 1) watch p50/p95 for 2h, 2) confirm no spike in cache eviction events, 3) validate client 502s cleared. I'll update status every 30m.

support-lead: I'll draft a short customer note for AcmeCorp/NovaApps explaining: minor canary regression after opt-in feature flag, immediate kill + rollback applied, monitoring in place, next update in 2 hours.

jordan: PR opened: `fix/kv-prefetch-backoff` -> will add configurable concurrency and jitter. Will request review from @maria and @alex.

incident-bot: Action items captured: [owner:jordan] craft hotfix PR, [owner:sahil] monitor canary 2h, [owner:alex] confirm rollback logs & ticket, [owner:support-lead] customer comms.

maria: preliminary RCA (short): new kv prefetch optimizer aggressively prefetches many keys concurrently under certain long-input request patterns causing cache churn and increased tail latency. Root cause confirmed by canary telemetry.

support-lead: tagging this for postmortem. Will schedule a 30m blameless review tomorrow and assign postmortem doc to alex.

alex: thanks team. continuing to watch. :thumbsup:

sahil: 30m status: canary p95 steady ~170ms, error rate baseline. No new customer reports.

sahil: 2h status: still stable. closing pager and will follow up in retrospective.

incident-bot: Pager resolved (SEV2 -> monitored). Please file postmortem and link ops ticket #INC-2026-045.

jordan: hotfix merged to main, will queue canary redeploy with safeguards (reduced prefetch concurrency + dynamic backoff).

support-lead: Customer updates sent.

alex: assigning postmortem to myself, will include timeline, signal graphs, and action plan (rollout gating + automated flag kill heuristics).

maria: adding a unit/integration test to the prefetch module to prevent regression.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please add runbook entry for feature-flag kill steps on inference-hosted.

alex: closing thread; will upload postmortem and link here when done.
